name: Xinya Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinya Electronic Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of various types of cable in China and internationally. The company offers consumer electronic cable products, such as electrical wiring, power cable, and holder cable; PV cable, new energy charging cable, and energy storage cable; monitoring medical and medical device communication cable; and PCIe high-speed transmission, SAS high-speed transmission, and external high-speed transmission cables.
